name: @loui/dsp-wasm
description: WASM build of loui-dsp — generated by wasm-bindgen from dsp-core/crates/loui-dsp-wasm

scripts.build: if [ "$CI" = 'true' ] && [ -f pkg/loui_dsp_wasm_bg.wasm ]; then echo '[dsp-wasm] pre-built artifacts present — skipping rebuild in CI'; else bash ../../dsp-core/scripts/build-wasm-bindings.sh; fi
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:worklet && pnpm run build:node
